turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Who decided on the zero, and did anyone talk to Owen first?
Before we start, I reread Owen's last three essays this morning.
You haven't answered me. Who entered the zero, and was Owen heard before it went in?
He writes like someone who was read to every night. That was you, wasn't it?
Leave my evenings out of it, Hale. What do you actually have on that essay?
You've raised a genuinely thoughtful kid. I mean that.
Then why does my genuinely thoughtful kid have a zero?
Which is why I'd hate for this to become a fight between two people who obviously both care about him.
It became a fight when it went into the gradebook. Show me something or I'm going down the hall.
